Glød Glød, a wood-fire kitchen and natural wine bar in copenhagen Book a table Overview Lunch at the weekend The kitchen ‘Nothing goes on the menu until it has been on the fire.’ Freja Lindqvist, chef and owner Our story Our story Since 2019 Freja grew up salting fish on Fanø and cooked in Paris and Lofoten before coming home to open Glød on Jægersborggade. Langoustines from Læsø, vegetables from two farms on Stevns, and rye bread baked in the embers every afternoon. Since 2019 Seven winters at the fire 2019 The old bakery on Jægersborggade becomes Glød. One hearth, twenty-eight seats. 2021 Baglokalet opens behind the kitchen, with one long oak table for twenty-four. 2022 Elin comes over from Svaneke
